purpose: 从已验证 v2 bundle 与本轮非 Storage 上下文建立唯一 Persona projection，并从真实 NPC 对话入口注入 persona_dsl。

authority.predecessor: docs/persona-awake-joint-g3-a0-scope.v1.json must be approved, verified and lease-released

requiredEvidence.runtimeTestHarness: AWAKE.Tests/Program.cs captures the rawVariables passed by the real NpcDialogueService prompt-build path; direct PersonaDslGenerator calls are supplementary only.
testCases: PWB-AWAKE-010 invokes the real NPC prompt-build path with a verified v2 bundle and proves ContextSnapshot is non-Storage, Provider is the sole Persona projection caller, persona_dsl reaches Prompts.CompileAsync, and WorldbookService.BuildPersona is not invoked.

PWB-AWAKE-011 changes exactly one overlay, activation, scene, relation/state or ContextModes input; it proves the canonical fingerprint changes, the cached Persona projection is invalidated, and the next prompt receives the changed DSL.

PWB-AWAKE-019 loads a valid bundle, then attempts invalid bundle, overlay and activation reloads; it proves the published RuntimeBundle, activation metadata, Knowledge projection, Persona DSL and fingerprint remain the previous last-known-good values.

PWB-AWAKE-020 exercises missing bundle, invalid bundle and incomplete runtime context; it proves the fixed identity-only RUNTIME_FALLBACK is emitted and the production path does not invoke WorldbookService.BuildPersona.
implementationObligations: Remove the production NpcDialogueService reference/call to WorldbookRuntime.Current.BuildPersona before any G3-A acceptance can pass; legacy BuildPersona may remain only in an explicitly offline compatibility boundary with no production caller.
RuntimeBundle, ContextSnapshot and PersonaRuntimeProvider must exist and be reachable from the production NPC caller before PWB-AWAKE-010 can pass.
No G3-A acceptance may be inferred from A0/G0 static-gate output or symbol/grep presence.
negativeCases: missing-or-invalid-bundle emits fixed identity-only RUNTIME_FALLBACK without WorldbookService.BuildPersona
invalid reload preserves bundle, activation metadata, Knowledge projection, Persona DSL and fingerprint
each overlay or activation mutation invalidates the next Persona projection
each canonical fingerprint input changes the fingerprint while unrelated values do not
commands: verify-g3-a0-predecessor.ps1 with the signed scope's A0 approval and lease hashes

nonGoals: game sync, game launch, publication or BuildId change
